hackathons.title: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity professionals
hackathons.summary: Black Hat India 2026 Official CTF is a cybersecurity challenge hosted on CTF7. The event focuses on evaluating participants' technical expertise across various security and exploitation disciplines.

hackathons.title: Q-HACK INDIA 2026
hackathons.summary: Q-HACK INDIA 2026 is an offline hackathon featuring no restricted themes for participating developers. Attendees collaborate to build software solutions and compete in a hands-on coding environment.

hackathons.title: HackInverse 1.0
hackathons.summary: HackInverse 1.0 is an in-person hackathon in Kolkata focusing on web development, mobile development, and artificial intelligence. The two-day event encourages participants to build innovative tech projects.

hackathons.title: CODEARAMBH 2.0
hackathons.summary: CODEARAMBH 2.0 is an online open-theme hackathon open to developers and computer science students. Participants work virtually to develop creative software applications across diverse technical domains.

hackathons.title: Arc Microgrants | Circle
hackathons.summary: Arc Microgrants by Circle provides developers with funding support to create novel software applications. Participants compete online for grant awards totaling $6,000.

hackathons.title: CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge
hackathons.summary: CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge is an online hackathon centered on artificial intelligence and software design. Developers collaborate to build innovative AI-driven tools and digital solutions.

hackathons.title: AI Lodge Hackathon 2026
hackathons.summary: Hosted by Singapore Management University, this online hackathon encourages students to tackle real-world problems using AI. Successful teams win prizes from a $2,500 pool.

hackathons.title: Multimodal AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.organizer: KamandPrompt – Programming Club of IIT Mandi
hackathons.summary: Organized by IIT Mandi's programming club, this online competition centers on multimodal AI development. Participants create AI models that process diverse data modalities.

hackathons.title: Build With AI: Basics 2026
hackathons.summary: Devpost hosts this beginner-friendly online hackathon to encourage foundational AI application development. Participants compete for $850 in total prize money.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Teams of 3-5 participants led by an engineering student or young engineer under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon challenges student-led engineering teams to develop solutions for sustainable transport engineering. Participants receive official challenges online and collaborate remotely to solve real-world problems.
